proves.claim: clause 1: seatItemFolderHints for a claimed item whose folder does not exist returns no line containing that path.

cli.io-hook-commit-msg.hint-names-existi.why: Without it a refused commit in the seat sends the builder to a folder that was never created.

proves.claim: clause 2: an item with no folder gets the line naming pullboard claim with its id, and an item whose folder exists still gets the cd line with its real path.

cli.io-hook-commit-msg.hint-for-missing-.why: Without it a builder with no item folder is left with no next step, or an item with a folder loses its cd line.
